readmeMarkdown:
Agent Guard

Zero-dependency safety net & automatic per-turn git checkpoints for Google Antigravity

English · 简体中文

--- **Agent Guard** protects your workspace and host machine while coding with autonomous agents in **Google Antigravity** (Desktop 2.0, IDE, and CLI `agy`) — with **zero npm dependencies** and **zero modifications to `app.asar`**. ## Features - **Catastrophic Command Gate (`PreToolUse`)** - **Hard block (`deny`)**: Terminating `Antigravity` itself, wiping `/`, `~`, `$HOME`, system drives (`C:\`, `C:\Windows`, `$env:USERPROFILE`), `format`, `mkfs`, `diskpart`, `dd of=/dev/...`. - **Mandatory confirmation (`force_ask`)**: `git push --force`, `git reset --hard`, `git clean -f`, `git checkout .`, `git branch -D`, `git stash clear`, `DROP TABLE` / `TRUNCATE`, `npm/cargo/twine publish`, OS registry/boot/power commands. - **Standard confirmation (`ask`)**: Recursive directory deletes (`rm -rf`, `Remove-Item -Recurse`) and remote pipe-to-shell (`curl | sh`, `irm | iex`). - **Sandbox-aware**: Preserves Antigravity's native `BypassSandbox` confirmation boundary while letting safe sandboxed commands run without friction. - **Invisible Per-Turn Checkpoints (`PreInvocation`)** - Snapshots the full git working copy (tracked + untracked, excluding `.gitignore`) into `refs/agent-guard/` before the first model call of each turn. - Never touches `HEAD`, your branch, staged index, or `git stash`. Deduplicates identical trees and retains the latest 50 checkpoints. - **Undoable Rollback (`agent-guard` Skill + CLI)** - Every `restore` automatically saves a pre-restore backup ref so even a rollback can be undone. ## Quick Install **Requirements:** Node.js >= 20, Git. **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Echoqili/agent-guard/main/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Echoqili/agent-guard/main/install.sh | sh ``` **Antigravity CLI (`agy`):** ```bash git clone https://github.com/Echoqili/agent-guard.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agent-guard agy plugin enable agent-guard ``` **npm / npx** (no Git required — installs into `~/.gemini/config/plugins` and runs self-tests): ```bash npx -y @echoqili/agent-guard agy plugin enable agent-guard ``` > **macOS note:** if you start Antigravity from Dock/Finder and Node.js was installed via Homebrew or NVM, the GUI process may not see `node` on its `PATH` and the hooks will silently do nothing. Launch Antigravity from a terminal (which has your shell `PATH`), or register the path globally: > `launchctl setenv PATH "/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"` then restart the client. ## Usage Ask the agent directly in chat: - *"What files did you change in this turn?"* - *"Roll back all edits from the last turn"* - *"List all agent-guard checkpoints"* Or run the CLI directly inside any git repository: ```bash node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agent-guard/scripts/guard.mjs list node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agent-guard/scripts/guard.mjs diff 1 node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agent-guard/scripts/guard.mjs restore 1 node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agent-guard/scripts/guard.mjs snapshot "before refactor" ``` ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
latestReleaseNotes:
Initial release of **agent-guard**: a zero-dependency safety gate and per-turn git checkpoints for Google Antigravity.

- `PreToolUse` command gate: hard-deny catastrophic commands (wiping roots/system drives, formatting, killing Antigravity); force-ask on history-destroying ops (force push, reset --hard, DROP TABLE, npm publish); ask on recursive deletes and curl|sh.
- Sandbox-aware: preserves Antigravity's native BypassSandbox boundary.
- `PreInvocation` per-turn checkpoints into `refs/agent-guard/`: never touches HEAD/index/stash, deduplicates, keeps latest 50.
- Undoable rollback via the `agent-guard` skill + CLI.
- Cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), zero npm dependencies, no `app.asar` modification.
- One-line installers (`install.ps1` / `install.sh`) with macOS GUI PATH fallback.

Validated with `agy plugin validate --strict` — zero warnings. Full docs: README.md / README.zh-CN.md.
